name: dataflow_fixed_T32
purpose: Synthesize first streaming fixed architecture at T=32 after exact butterfly agreement with the actual-ap_fixed-boundary reference. Ideal multiplication budget 162+64+25=251 DSP, compute floor 2,080,800 frame cycles plus weight load, padding and pipeline overhead; these are predictions, not measured results.
changes: Same streaming source as float E030; internal AP_RND_CONV/AP_SAT w10a10 with 23-bit full-product accumulators and on-chip runtime parameter load.
interpretation: Read all loop II and dataflow warnings. T is fold schedule, not a promise of end-to-end pixel II: pipeline fill/drain, line updates and pad-row stalls must be measured. E017 verifies all actual quantization points; the separately running full ap_fixed E012 will independently confirm the arithmetic reference.
conclusion: Compare achieved resources, latency and II before scanning T. Missing Set14 comic means precision acceptance is provisional.
